root_cause: connection pool leak in checkout-service: connections acquired on the request path are never returned, so the pool saturates and later requests fail waiting for one

evidence.observation: rose from 0.0 to 0.778, having been flat at zero through the baseline
evidence.supports: the pool is exhausted, not merely busy

evidence.observation: 10 leak events, none in the baseline
evidence.supports: connections are acquired and not returned - the leak itself

evidence.observation: 713 timeout events, none in the baseline
evidence.supports: requests fail waiting for a connection, downstream of the exhaustion
the connection acquisitions that never completed
the user-visible impact follows the pool saturation, it does not precede it

ruled_out: bad release (v2.8 deployment) - no deployment event appears in the window, and both db_pool_timeout and connection_leaked carry version=v2.7, so the running version did not change
inventory-service internal error masked as out-of-stock - dependency_error is only x12 with status=409 while db_pool_usage reached 0.778; that pattern leaves db_pool_usage near 0.1
memory leak - memory_mb went 90.4 to 93.5 and cache_entries stayed at 0, both listed among the metrics that stayed normal
